_comment: Copy to config/baselines/security.local.json to change expectations. Two groups of checks: Microsoft security posture, and the MSP standard setup our onboarding creates (break-glass, mspadmin, hidden contacts, IT@ and MSPalerts@ lists, technical contact). Each check: expected value (true/false, a string, a number, or {min,max}), severity, and the remediation (a task script in this repo, or 'manual'). Test-M365SecurityBaseline.ps1 compares a tenant against this and never changes anything. The MSP checks need the client config (-Client) so the audit knows the client's alias and domain.
name: MSP Microsoft 365 security baseline

checks.title: MFA required for all users (Security Defaults, or an enabled CA policy for All users and All cloud apps)
checks.remediation: security/Set-M365SecurityDefaults.ps1 -State On, or an enabled CA policy requiring MFA for All users, All cloud apps and all client apps

checks.title: Legacy authentication blocked (Security Defaults or CA)
checks.remediation: security/Set-M365SecurityDefaults.ps1 -State On, or an enabled CA policy for All users and All cloud apps that blocks Exchange ActiveSync and other clients

checks.title: Unified audit log ingestion enabled
Mailbox auditing on by default
Automatic external forwarding blocked (default outbound spam policy Off, and no enabled custom policy allowing it)
checks.remediation: security/Set-M365ExternalForwarding.ps1 -Mode Off (default policy); set any custom policy named in Actual to Off by hand: Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy -Identity <name> -AutoForwardingMode Off

checks.title: External sender tag in Outlook enabled
Modern authentication (OAuth2) enabled in Exchange Online
SMTP AUTH disabled organization-wide
checks.remediation: security/Set-M365SmtpAuth.ps1 -State Off (re-enable per mailbox for devices that need it)

checks.title: Anti-phish spoof intelligence enabled on the default policy
DKIM signing enabled on every custom accepted domain
Password expiration disabled (Microsoft and NIST guidance)
Self-service password reset allowed
checks.remediation: manual: Entra admin center > Password reset

checks.title: Users cannot consent to third-party apps
checks.remediation: manual: Entra admin center > Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions

checks.title: Guest invitations limited to admins and guest inviters (or disabled)
checks.remediation: manual: Entra admin center > External identities > External collaboration settings

checks.title: Between 2 and 4 Global Administrators (including break-glass)
checks.remediation: entra/Get-M365UserReview.ps1 to list admins; remove roles by hand

checks.title: Break-glass account exists
No shared mailbox with sign-in enabled
MSP: break-glass account holds Global Administrator
MSP: break-glass account is excluded from every enabled Conditional Access policy
MSP: mspadmin account exists
MSP: our support address is a technical notification contact
MSP: client alias (<name>.clients@) exists as a mail contact hidden from the GAL
MSP: support address exists as a mail contact hidden from the GAL
MSP: IT@<domain> distribution list exists with our contact as a member
MSP: MSPalerts@<domain> distribution list exists with the support contact as a member
